name: Rude Words
author: byo-pop
description: Adds about 300 swear words, crude slang and internet slang that BookWorm's dictionary leaves out (no slurs). Playing one sets new tiles on fire, and Lex has something to say about it. The settings change its points, the fire and the bonus tiles. The game-over screen counts the rude words of the game and of all time. Works with Collins Scrabble Words too. Games with it keep their own high scores.

settings.label: Points multiplier
settings.help: A rude word's points are multiplied by this: 0 scores nothing, below 0 takes points away (never below the level's start).

settings.label: Every new tile burns
settings.help: Every tile that drops in to replace a rude word comes in burning (but none on the bottom row).

settings.label: Fire tiles
settings.help: How many of the new tiles burn: always the same number, or one for so many letters of the word.

settings.label: Letters per fire tile
settings.help: One fire tile for every so many letters of the word (at least one).

settings.label: Bonus tiles

choices.label: A rude word removes them all

settings.help: Whether a rude word still earns a bonus tile (gold, sapphire, diamond), and whether it turns every bonus tile on the board (green ones too) back into a plain one.

settings.label: Lex comments
settings.help: Lex's balloon has a comment on each rude word (and its definition, with definitions on), and he cries danger.
